leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Define a functional component with TypeScript to structure the UI.
Apply the useState hook to declare a boolean state variable for visibility.
Implement a handler function to toggle the boolean state using the setter function.
Utilize conditional rendering to control the display of an element based on state.
Construct a button element within the JSX structure.
Assign the handler function to the button's onClick event.
Control the button's text content dynamically by accessing the current state value.
Return the component's JSX with the button and conditionally rendered content.
